segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: To our Department of Agriculture family,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: led by Secretary Francisco Kiko Tiu Laurel Jr.,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: in the National Irrigation Administration family,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: led by Administrator Eduardo Eddie Guillen,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: our partners from the Civil Society Organization

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: and all colleagues participating in today's budget hearing,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Today, our task is not merely to review our profession,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: but to support in sharpening the agri-sector's direction,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: improve the incomes of farmers and peasant folks,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: and ensure that assistance reaches producers in the right place and at the right time.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: As President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. reminded us,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: our national budget serves as our moral and economic compass,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: always pointing toward making life better for our people.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: The fiscal year 2027 NEP proposes P198.45 billion for the DA in its attached corporations,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: while P46.36 billion is proposed as budgetary support

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: for the DA in its attached corporations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: We support the Department's direction to treat these resources as one value-chain strategy,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: from land, water, credit, and mechanized production to poor harvest facilities,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: logistic, market matching, and better return for producers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: and digital market information should work together

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: to reduce transport costs and spoilage,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: and connect farmers and peasant folks with reliable buyers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: And because water is the lifeblood of our field,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: the fiscal year 2027 NEP proposes P46.36 billion in budgetary support for NIA,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: with only 2.20 million hectares developed out of the country,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: 3.13 million hectares of potential irrigatable area,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: and more than 1.5 million hectares of land.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: We support NIA's direction to accelerate irrigation development

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: while giving equal attention to refer restoration,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: climate adoption, and service road improvements,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: irrigation, funding, and projects should be coordinated

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: We also support NIA's commitment to improve the quality of the water and the environment

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: so that every new or restored system immediately support additional production in diversified cropping.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Production support must also include timely and affordable agricultural credit,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: peasant folks, cooperatives, and farmers' associations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Mechanization through PELMIG in the DA Banners Program

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: must improve labor and output efficiency,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: expand harvesting, drying, storage, and processing capacity,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: and reduce losses between harvest and market credit.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Equipment, training, insurance, and market access should be delivered,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: as an integrated package in coordination with LGUs and local farmers

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Every allocation proposed for the year 2027

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: must be authored on a clear purpose,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: a defined intervention in a missionable result.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: We must be able to explain,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: not only how much we are requesting,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: but why we are requesting it,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: who will benefit in what improvement.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: We expect to see where program have demonstrated results.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: We must identify how to sustain our scale of this gain,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: where implementation challenges have been increased,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: and how to be the key to the improvement.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: This must be addressed through better planning,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: stronger education, and more program design.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: to arrive at a budget proposal that is credible,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: and capable of delivering meaningful results

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: I hope that the government of the Philippines will provide us with a number of means for developing a more robust and sustainable program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: The committee will look for clear regional and community targets, accessible credit, operational irrigation system, lower post-harvest losses, stronger market, matching, and better day-to-day coordination that gives local farmers a direct voice in planning and implementation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: At this point, before the agencies begin their representation, I would like to introduce the sponsor of today's budget, Vice Chairman Dr. Anna York, our lead sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Congressman York cannot join us physically as he is attending the needs of our constituents in Pampanga, which until now may baha pa po doon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Of course, your trolleys, Congressman Bong Tebes, and the sponsor of NIA budget, Vice Chairman Joseph Tan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: With that, I welcome everyone today for Fiscal Year 2027 Department of Culture and National Irrigation Administration Budget Hearing.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: We look forward to support today in NIA moving these reforms toward...

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: ...a more productive, efficient, and resilient agricultural sector.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Thank you, and I wish everyone a productive discussion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Mr. Chairman, Mr. Chairman, Rufus Rodriguez here, Mr. Chairman.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: May I raise a point of inquiry?

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: The budget hearing schedule promulgated by the Committee on Appropriations has two agencies at the same time, 1030,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: ...with Secretary Benitez, and NIA, with Administrator Guillen.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: May I know whether this will be successive or it will be joined at the same time, and we will be given 10 minutes each?

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Okay, thank you very much. Five minutes each.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: So, we'll all be able to ask five minutes to the DA, five minutes to the NIA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Thank you for that ruling, Mr. Chairman.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: The clarification: five minutes, joint NIA and DA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Oh, I thought that it will be separate because many here, like me, I have combined.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Because I have many questions. There are many agencies in the DA and I have many questions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And then with NIA, I have also questions because I got zero in the NEP in NIA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: So, may we know whether we should add some more minutes because five minutes will not be sufficient for both big agencies of government with separate budgets.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: May we know what will be the consideration of the Chair?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: I think, siguro, flexible na lang tayo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: But anyway, there will be a consultation on Thursday, September 3, for DA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: That's why, yung inyong mga parang keyal concern, pwede niyong ma-address doon during consultation sa DA this coming Thursday.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: But, boss, siguro, flexible na lang natin kung lalampas tayo ng five minutes.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: But anyway, ang rules po na natin is for five minutes.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: I hope when Kaganyoro speaks, we'll be given another five minutes.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: I joined the manifestation of Honorable Rodriguez, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: In fact, this representation also had so many concerns, not only on the DA, but more particularly on the NIA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: So, I think more than five minutes is enough for us, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: And then, before the day of presentation, let us hear from the Vice Chair Bundok, my co-lead for her message.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Thank you so much, Pong Tevez and Vice Chair Tevez.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Thank you so much, everyone, and good morning.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: I hope you can hear me.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: I am the Vice Chair in charge of the Department of Agriculture, and I am pleased to welcome everyone to our consultation and budget presentation of the Department of Agriculture for the 2027 budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Unfortunately, I cannot join you and cannot be physically present today because of severe and persistent flooding in Central Luzon, Pampanga, and most especially in my district.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: The San Simon-Enlex exit, which has now caused a 10-hour backlog and a Carmageddon, which is causing problems not only for our district, but for the entire Metro Manila and the entire north, is in my district also.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Nevertheless, I am honored to welcome everyone today.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Thank you so much to Secretary Francisco Kiko Tiu Laurel Jr. of the Department of Agriculture and to the DA family.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: I would like to recognize our NIA Administrator, Admin Eduardo Eddie-Guillen today.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: To my colleagues who are taking over for me today, Congressman Joseph Tan, who is representing the NIA, Vice Chair Pong Tevez, and also Vice Chair Christopher Gua.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Thank you so much for assisting me during these difficult times.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Nevertheless, we are here today to address so many issues facing the DA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: which is food security, the stability of food prices, the welfare of farmers, support for our economy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: And I think one of the most important issues today is recovery from the flood,

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: which is the worst flood which has ever occurred in the Philippines,

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: and sadly has occurred in the rice granary of the Philippines, Central Luzon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: And of course, we must face the challenges of climate change,

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: which is one of the major causes of the El Nino flood, which is ravaging Philippine agriculture today.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Together with the DA family and the NIA, we welcome your concerns and will try to address them accordingly.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Thank you for your questions and we will work together with you,

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: hopefully to a successful support for the 2027 budget of the Department of Agriculture and the National Irrigation Authority.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: So thank you so much, everyone. Maya Payabak po, and good morning.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Secretary Laurel, you may now proceed with your presentation.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Honorable members of Congress, distinguished colleagues, ladies and gentlemen,

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: We are here today to present the Department of Agriculture's proposed budget for fiscal year 2027

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: and to seek the continued support of the Department of Agriculture and the National Irrigation Authority.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: The President emphasized in his budget message,

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: the national budget must ultimately make a difference in the lives of our people.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: For the Department of Agriculture, that means two things that are inseparable,

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: ensuring that the Filipino families have sufficient, safe, nutritious, and affordable food,

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: and making sure that farmers and fisher folks,

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: who produce that food, can earn a decent and sustainable living.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: We cannot have one without the other.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: We cannot demand affordable food while leaving those who produce it struggling to cover their costs.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: And we cannot expect our farmers and fisher folks to keep producing for the nation

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: if farming and fishing no longer provide them with a viable livelihood and a better life for their families.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: This is why agriculture must be properly and sufficiently funded.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Every investment we make in agriculture is, at its core, an investment in food security.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: Our fiscal year 2027 budget proposal is firmly anchored on NIA's seven-point strategic agenda,

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Chair, well recognized niyong ating mga proponente.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Ang problema sa, like recently dito sa Habagat, tumuhumal ang benta sa mga merkado sa ating mga palengke.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Kaya medyo tumuhumal din yung bentahan ng high value crops galing sa Benguet.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: At ang nadesisyon na ito actually earlier this year na magtatayo tayo ng cold storage na 5 mega cold storage

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: at processing center dun sa lupa ng Benguet State University

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: as one of the solutions to have a 15 day buffer stocking area and processing for yung mga excess production natin.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Meanwhile, meron din tayong food hub na ipapabid na sa Clark with the 2026 gaan na 2 billion pesos

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: So that is part of the network na tinatayo natin for the high value crops.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: At para nga meron tayong shock absorber at storage systems to address yung spikes or highs and lows ng production.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngayon naman, Mr. Chair, nananatili pa rin ho ang Pilipinas na number one na rice importer sa buong mundo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At sa harap ngayon ng bantanang super-aluminium, climate emergency, mga gera, at mga potential na disruption sa ating global rice supply.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Hindi ba delikado para sa ating food security na ang Pilipinas po ang laki pa rin ng pag-asa ng kanyang dependence sa ibang bansa para sa ating panggawa?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ano na yung pagkain? Ano ho ang aksyon ng DA para rito?

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Chair, definitely, ang pangarap po natin ay mabawasan yung ating dependency sa importasyon.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: At napaka-importante hung ma-suportahan natin ang NIA sa pag-irrigate ng more of our flatlands na tinatawag, lalo na sa rice production.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Meanwhile, tuloy-tuloy naman yung ating development of the...

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: for use ng ating development ng inbred seeds natin at pati yung locally produced hybrid seeds natin.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: At actually, unting-unting tumataas ang ating yield per hectare base sa datos.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: So, we're in the right path but we really need more irrigated land.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: As far as food security natin for rice for year 2026, I'm happy to announce na we are quite secure.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Sa ating rice requirements till end of 2026.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: But pumasok na rin ho, nag-umpisa na ho ang harvest season din natin ngayon sa ating mga palayan.

DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: ...see you some of these days para makita mo, ano, one of these days, I mean, para makita mo talaga yung lugar kung saan itatayo natin yung Mega Hatchery.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Ang pangatlo ko, Secretary Laurel, na problema natin, yung FMR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Last year, sa NEP, nabigyan po tayo ng apat kasi yung lugar namin, agricultural...

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: ...province kami. So, in fact, yung na-validate natin is more than 200 farm-to-market roads.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Apat lang yung naibigay sa atin. Unfortunately, nung lumabas ang GAA, dalawa ang nawala.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: So, if you recall, I went to your office. Sabi mo, hanapan mo ng paraan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Ang problema, nung tinignan ko ang NEP ngayon, dalawa lang ang nailagay sa akin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Yung commitment natin na nawala ang dalawa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: At what is worse there, Mr. Chairman, Secretary, yung dalawang naibigay nyo sa akin, 2026 budget,

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: hindi pa na-implement ngayon dahil yung isa, o yung dalawa, in fact, may nagka-problema sa funding.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Kasi, nung in-apply ng DPWH yung standard program works nila, nagkukulang.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: So, that's why we agreed na ibalik ko na lang sa inyo, kayo na pang bahala.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Yun na nga, nung gumawa ng program of works yung office nyo, lagpas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Kulang yung 15 million in one kilometer.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: So, sabi mo sa akin, kayo na bahala, dagdagan ninyo para matapos ang one kilometer.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Kasi, people are expecting that project.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Unfortunately, tinignan ko rin sa NEP ngayon, kulang ng 18 million para matapos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Hindi ko makita sa NEP kung...

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Saan kayo kukuha ng source para matapos yun?

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Chair, yung una nga, apat yung ating naka-plano dyan.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: But, of course, we were assuming the fiscal space na meron kami.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Like, akala namin yung budget for 2027 is same as 2026 na 33.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: But, unfortunately, kalahati rin yung nakuha namin.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: nabanggit ko rin nga talaga sa inyo na susubukan natin punuin yung natitirang kulang doon sa kilometro.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: At ang nakikita namin paraan is meron kaming nakikita na unimplementables sa FMR ng 2026.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Doon namin planong kunin doon sa mga projects na hindi ma-implement.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Dahil nga, let's say, dating pwedeng implement, tapos nabaha na ngayon at na-wash out.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: At hindi na pwedeng gawan ng kalye.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Yun yung mga ganong klase yung nakikita namin.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: I will take note, Mr. Chair, and coordinate closely with Kong Bancoro on this matter.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: So, assured na tayo na matapos talaga yun kasi mahihiyan naman tayo sa mga tao na kulang, hindi tapos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Yung dalawang nawala ko, Mr. Chair, anong commitment natin doon?

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Yung dalawang FMR natin na nawala?

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Yung dalawang nawala, sa ngayon, kung hindi madadagdagan ng FMR budget, Mr. Chair, ng DA for 2027,

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: yun ang aming, kung pwedeng pagtulong-tulungan natin na madagdagan yung FMR budget sa final gaah, I think, yun ang isang paraan, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Sige po, aasahan ko po yun, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Tsaka susulat rin ako dyan for that purpose para on record siya.

Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro

segments.text: Excuse me, with all your respect.

segments.text: same sa sagot mo sa akin last year.

segments.text: yun na nga, maliit lang budget binigay mo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: And, nalaman ko na lang, may binaba kayo solar irrigation na wala,

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: bakit ako binigyan ng solar irrigation,

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: matanggap natin yan na ganito yung amount.

segments.text: bigyan naman naman ako na solar irrigation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Ito talaga ang priority namin, sir.

segments.text: Ano yung direction natin dyan, sir?

segments.text: Yung presentation ng NUAB sa budget niya.

segments.text: I know we have limited time here.

segments.text: If you give me some time,

segments.text: Kasi, advocate po ako ng organic agriculture.

segments.text: I will officially write you on that.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: To the NIA, Mr. Chair, may I ask the Administrator, we noticed a significant change in your fiscal year 2026 NIA budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And special provision number 8 was added, restricting modifications to the project list.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Did these changes, Mr. Chair, help NIA implement its budget better?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Or did they somehow contribute to the drop in your utilization?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: What was the actual effect dun po sa inyong implementation?

NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: Ano po, yung budget utilization rate natin ay bumaba po dahil napaka-strict, napaka-stringent po yung special provisions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So, based on your experience, ano hong budget structure ang ire-recommend nyo sa Kongreso?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Pero hindi po maaantala yung inyong implementation.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: Well, Sir, Sir Chair, based on our experience, NIA prefers a program-based appropriation under PREC-C.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: Yung gaya po ng dati, before 2026, yung 2025 and prior, ganoon po kasi dati.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: But, of course, it will still be supported by detailed, validated, and transparent.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: A project list submitted separately, of course, to Congress and DBM.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: Magsasubmit pa rin po kami dun, ano po.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: Ang maganda po dito, this arrangement, ano po, provides the best balance between transparency and accountability.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: Lalong-lalo na po yung implementation flexibility, ano po, and responsiveness to actual field conditions.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: And yung timely and efficient utilization ng aming mga projects.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: Actually, this does not give NIA unlimited authority po to replace projects.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: Any adjustment must remain within the approved program and comply with budgeting, procurement, and auditing and reporting requirements.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So, ang sinasabi nyo po, based on your previous experience, bago po i-implement yung Special Provision No. 8,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: wala po kayo naging problema sa utilization nyo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: At madali kayong, mas nagkaroon kayo ng elbow room para i-implement yung projects.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: Yes, Mr. Chair. Tingnan nyo po, lalo na po ito.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: You have to understand po yung situation ng NIA.

segments.text: Hindi namin magalaw ngayon yung aming repair and restoration.

NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: Like, again, yung in-explain ko sa inyo kanina.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: And, for some reason, alimbawa po yung budget namin ngayon, across the board, na nagbawas.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: Kasi may naging problema sa highways.

segments.text: Pati kami, nabawasan yung aming budget.

segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair, and, ah, with, ah, due respect to all the members of the, ah, committee and to our secretary,

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Cheryl Marie Natividad-Caballero
segments.text: um, I just wanted to state, Mr. Chair, that the high-value crops,

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Cheryl Marie Natividad-Caballero
segments.text: development program is one of the priority programs of the DA.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Cheryl Marie Natividad-Caballero
segments.text: It's intended to help address food security and in ensuring available, accessible, affordable, nutrient-dense food at all times.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Cheryl Marie Natividad-Caballero
segments.text: The high-value crops development program contributes to the following objectives.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Cheryl Marie Natividad-Caballero
segments.text: Improve the overall performance of priority high-value crops industries by at least 2.5% yearly.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Cheryl Marie Natividad-Caballero
segments.text: Increase farmers' income by at least 50% through diversification and value addition.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Cheryl Marie Natividad-Caballero
segments.text: Increase low-income crops by at least 2.5% yearly.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Cheryl Marie Natividad-Caballero
segments.text: Increase low-income crops by at least 2.5% yearly.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Cheryl Marie Natividad-Caballero
segments.text: Increase local and global competitiveness of high-value crops by looking at premium products.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Cheryl Marie Natividad-Caballero
segments.text: And orchestrate localized operating mechanism to connect the transition from production to nutrition

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Cheryl Marie Natividad-Caballero
segments.text: under the development of local economic enterprises and develop economically-sized production areas.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Cheryl Marie Natividad-Caballero
segments.text: With this, Mr. Chair, we humbly request, ah, this honorable body, ah, to, ah, allow us to have at least an 8 billion increase of the budget,

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Cheryl Marie Natividad-Caballero
segments.text: which is, currently, we only have 1.7 billion.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Cheryl Marie Natividad-Caballero
segments.text: Um, this is based po doon sa mga realizations that post-harvest losses is extremely high.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Cheryl Marie Natividad-Caballero
segments.text: And, ah, the post-harvest losses does not only start at the production level.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Cheryl Marie Natividad-Caballero
segments.text: It goes down to the distribution.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Cheryl Marie Natividad-Caballero
segments.text: So, what we humbly request, ah, given these challenges on, um, El Nino, ah, and, ah, the value addition that has to be added to diversify farmers' income,

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Cheryl Marie Natividad-Caballero
segments.text: is, is to have that increase po, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Cheryl Marie Natividad-Caballero
segments.text: Since the inception of high-value crops in 1995, we were pegged with only 1 billion, ah, budget.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Cheryl Marie Natividad-Caballero
segments.text: So, I think with, with the, ah, multiple, ah, crops that we can look into,

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: Center regarding our milk production, local milk production, may I ask them to join us

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: The NDA plays a crucial and much appreciated role in the implementation of the Masustansyang

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: As one of the lead agencies of the milk feeding program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: However, I would like to know, get the information from your agency, how much is really being

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: produced by our local dairy farmers?

segments.speaker: NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
segments.text: Mr. Chair, as of 2025, as of 2024, excuse me, the milk production was just 29 million liters.

segments.speaker: NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
segments.text: But as the PSA data shows, as of 2025, we increased it to 43 million, 43 million liters.

segments.speaker: NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
segments.text: But still, we agree on the observation that it's still not enough for the entire milk

segments.speaker: NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
segments.text: That's why we resort to sterilized milk, milk production.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: I see from your report that you have exceeded your targets for 2026.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: In fact, you have produced 21% of your milk.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: And you have produced 21% more than what you have produced for the same period between

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: January to June of 2025 at 25.38 million liters.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: And yet, this is just, what, 90%?

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: How much is still the percentage of imported dairy?

segments.speaker: NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
segments.text: Madam, Mr. Chair, as of today, as of 2025, we have also increased the milk sufficiency

segments.speaker: NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
segments.text: From 1% for the longest year to 2.2%.

segments.speaker: NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
segments.text: Still, the imported dairy is, in the average, 98%.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: During the hearing with the Department of Finance, as we were discussing the proposed

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: progress bill of the President, it was admitted by the Department of Finance that we, that

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: We are recommending that fermented and flavored milks remain as exempted to the sweetened beverage

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: And it is because that is what is being used in the feeding program of our school-based

NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: And you have a 3 billion budget for this?

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: I mean, the DSWD and the DepEd has allocated for their fresh milk feeding program around

segments.speaker: NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
segments.text: Yes, for NDA, it's about 3 billion.

segments.speaker: NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
segments.text: It is just for DepEd's milk feeding program.

segments.speaker: NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
segments.text: Not included the DSWD milk feeding program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: And it was you who said that that's the best incentive for our farmers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: That's the best incentive for our farmers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: dairy. Because if there's a demand, because we have a law, there's a demand for fresh milk.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: And let me just emphasize that what we are feeding our children now, these fermented milk

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: and flavored milk beverages, a single serving provides around 9 to 21 grams of sugar. That's

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: around 2.2 to 5 teaspoons of sugar per serving. So instead of helping our kids be more healthy,

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: be healthier, we are giving them this craving for sugar at a very young age. So kailangan po talaga

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: i-fast track natin ang ating programa sa dairy production, local dairy production. So can you

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: tell us, kanina si Congressman Rufus asked you,

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: for cattle, but I want to see the total picture, ano ang ginagawa ngayon ng National Dairy

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: and the Carabao Center for us to at least move forward so that we can produce our own milk

segments.speaker: NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
segments.text: for our children? Tama po, Mr. Chair. One of the reasons po bakit hindi dumadami ang ating

segments.speaker: NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
segments.text: milk production is napakakonti po ng ating mga alagang gatasang hayop. Dahil po sa mahabang

segments.speaker: NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
segments.text: panahon, ang ating mga iniimport ng mga alagang gatasang hayop,

segments.speaker: NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
segments.text: duretsong binibigay po sa farmers. At more often than not, ang mangyayari po dyan ay mamamatay.

segments.speaker: NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
segments.text: But for this year, nakapagtayo po tayo ng mga stock farms. Stock farms na kung saan natin po ilalagay

segments.speaker: NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
segments.text: ang mga imported animals para sila ma-acclimatize muna. Doon po muna sila magpaparami at pagka

segments.speaker: NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
segments.text: dumami na po sila, meron na po tayong source ng mga island-born dairy cattle na mas madali

segments.speaker: NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
segments.text: pong alagaan ng mga dairy farmers. Yan pong ginagawa po natin. Kaya yung mga dadating po natin

segments.speaker: NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
segments.text: mga imported dairy animals this October, hindi po natin magpaparami ng mga imported dairy animals.

segments.speaker: NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
segments.text: Yan diretsong ipamimigay muna. Dahil malamang sa malamang, mamamatay po yan. Ilalagay po na

segments.speaker: NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
segments.text: natin sa stock farms yan para maklimatay sila, dumami sila, at doon natin kukunin yung ating

segments.speaker: NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
segments.text: ipamamahagi kasi island-born na po sila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: Aside from yung ating cattle, kailangan rin nila ng particular grass, di ba? Kasama rin po ba yan sa programa ninyo?

segments.speaker: NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
segments.text: Tama po yan, Mr. Chair. Dahil po, kasama po sa binigay na budget po sa ating

segments.speaker: NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
segments.text: NDA ay yung pagpapagawa ng mga feed centers. Ito po mga feed centers ang tutugon sa pangangailangan po ng ating mga

segments.speaker: NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
segments.text: dairy farmers pagdating po sa pakain. Dahil alam naman po natin, ang prinsipyo sa dairy, garbage in, garbage out.

segments.speaker: NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
segments.text: Pakainin mo ng basura yan, basura ang gatas niyan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: Sinabi ninyong feeds, ano yun, magtatanim sila ng grass?

segments.speaker: NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
segments.text: Yes, not just grass po, including corn. Depende po sa lugar. May mga lugar po talaga na maganda magtanim ng mga corn.

segments.speaker: NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
segments.text: May mga lugar naman po na maganda magtanim ng mga corn.

segments.speaker: NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
segments.text: Magtanim ng grass, katulad po ng napier. At yung mga harvest po yan, dadalim po yan sa mga feed centers natin,

segments.speaker: NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
segments.text: kung saan yan ipoprocess para maging silage po, at upang ipamahagi po sa ating mga dairy farmers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: Sa presenting budget po ninyo, ano po ang na-anticipate ninyong increase sa local milk production?

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: And with the additional incentive for our farmers, kasi may ready market, may strong demand,

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: ang mga school feeding program, ano po ang nakikita ninyong targets for the next?

segments.speaker: NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
segments.text: Mr. Chair, actually, pagdating po sa milk feeding program, wala na po kami talaga ang maireklamo dahil napakagandang budget ang naibigay po sa National Dairy Authority para sa milk feeding program.

segments.speaker: NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
segments.text: Noong mga nakaraang panahon po kasi, ang problema ng ating mga magagatas, tumutulo po ang gatas, walang bumibili, literally tinatapon.

segments.speaker: NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
segments.text: But because of this milk feeding program, naingganyo po sila na alagaan ng hayop nila magpagatas.

segments.speaker: NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
segments.text: And that's one of the reasons why nag-increase ang milk production, dahil pinagahanda nila ang milk feeding program.

segments.speaker: NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
segments.text: Now, pagdating naman po sa budget ng NDA, may iiyak po kayo sa neb na naibigay sa amin.

segments.speaker: NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
segments.text: Nasa P216 lang po. Taman-tama lang po yung pang-sweldo. Actually, kulang pa po.

segments.speaker: NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
segments.text: Kaya po, napakasakitignan na ang mga kawani po ng NDA, sumusweldo pero walang gagawin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: Yung P3 billion na budget para sa milk feeding program ay direct ang mapupunta sa mga farmers at sa mga cooperatives, hindi po ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: At hindi naman talaga sa NDA.

segments.speaker: NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
segments.text: Yan po yung pera po ng debit for milk feeding program.

segments.speaker: NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
segments.text: Yung pera po ng debit for milk feeding program ay binigay po sa NDA at sa PCC upang ipamili namin ng gatas sa ating mga dairy farmers gamit ang sagipsaka.

segments.speaker: NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
segments.text: Kaya mas madali po natin may bibigay ang ating servisyo o ating mabibiling gatas sa mga farmers dahil diretsyo po natin ipoprofure sa kanila yan.

segments.speaker: NDA Administrator Marcus Antonius T. Andaya
segments.text: Hindi na po sila magpapatayan sa presyo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: Okay, so tingnan mo yung sitwasyon ng NDA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: Huwag mo masyadong, talagang kulang na kulang talaga sila sa pod.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: Yan, yan ang maganda, Chris Van Rufus.

Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: Surigao del Sur, particularly the Municipality of Marihatag, is considered one of the major producers of high-quality abaca fiber.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.

segments.text: while the rest of the provinces producing abaca are all in negative growth rate.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: Right now, a road network connecting the production site to the main national highway and market centers are about to be started,

segments.text: funded by the PRDP program, the program of the World Bank.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: And Municipality of Marihatag, kahit na maliit ho siya, six plus munis,

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: six plus municipality was able to post or to share 30% as a counterpart, which is 30 million po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: The area being developed is an IP community po, Manubo tribe ho ang nandyan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: and just recently been declared insurgent-free.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: Dahil yung lugar na yun ho dati ay hindi mapuntahan ng tao dahil talagang insurgent area, rebel infested yun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: And therefore, most of the farmers are rebel returnees.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: In order to help the Manubo tribe and the rebel returnees,

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: thus the establishment of Abaca Agro-Industrial Corridor in the Municipality of Marihatag, Surigao del Sur,

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: which was endorsed by RDC as one of the top 30 implementation-ready priority projects in Caraga.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: Kompleto na ho ng papili sito. May feasibility study ang lahat-lahat.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: Kompleto na ho ng papili sito. May feasibility study ang lahat-lahat.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: The total project cost is 739 million.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: But this year ang hiningi lang nila is 47 million lang po para to start with.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: Actually ang 47 million is for the establishment of Abaca Consolidation and Processing Center, if I am right.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: So para lang ho tayo maka-start, para ho mayroon ng bahay kung sa ibig sabihin pa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: Para tuloy-tuloy na ho ang ating programa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: Mr. Secretary, wala ng ibang provinces ang may ganun potential in Abaca except Surigao del Sur.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: Kaya nga ho kailangan siguro nating matulungan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: My question is ang 47 million ba ay naisama natin sa ating budget this year, 2027?

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Chair, ang sagot diyan is yes. Kaya lang nasa tier 2, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: When you mean tier 2, Secretary, is it not part of your budget, part of the GAO or your NEP right now?

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: Because there are tier 1 and tier 2s. I would suppose that's part of...

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Chair, ang problem daw, sabi namin USIC for Finance, hindi na-approve yung Tier 2 namin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: How do we go about it, Mr. Secretary? I think this is one of the best programs TILFIDA ever had.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Sige, sir. Meron kaming option. Kailangan lang talaga natin kalagyan ng bahay. May bahay na ba yan?

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Kailangan lang namin lagyan ng bahay. Meron kaming World Bank na pwedeng i-access, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: Actually, the 47 million is just for i-bahay so that the next budget, it will be Tier 1 na. Sana eh.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Sige, well, Mr. Chair, we will endeavor na mailagay natin. Tulungan natin, Mr. Chair, na malagay sa budget past Tier 1 kahit lagyan lang ng 5-10 million, then kami nang bahala magdagdag.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: Yes, po. In our side, we'll do also our part. My next question is addressed to BIFAR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: Of the 13 municipalities and one city in my district, 1st District of Surigao del Sur, 13 of these municipalities are situated along the coast.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: And therefore, 40% of our inhabitants, people in Surigao del Sur, are fishermen, Mr. Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: Our produce, the production, whatever derived or caught from fishing, are supplied.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: Supplied to our neighboring municipalities, provinces, and cities. At dahil dito po, kami ang nagsusupply.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: Right now, ito lang ho ang problema. Right now, although we are producing enough fish for reconsumption of our neighboring provinces and cities, wala ho kaming cold storage po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: Kaya yung aming mga fishermen ay mapilitan i-binta ng mura kung panahon na maraming kuha.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: So sana po, I have been, in fact, a resolution has already submitted, a resolution from the Municipality of Liangga, where the proposed cold storage will be established.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: E nandito na ho, nasabit na last year pa po. Sana mabigyan ng priority po ito.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Yes, Mr. Chair. Saan exactong lugar, Mr. Chair?

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: Actually, Mr. Secretary, Barangay St. Christine, Liangga, Surigao del Sur.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Yes, sir. Ang lagayin ho na ito, Mr. Chair, is ice plant and cold storage.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: And the last, Mr. Chairman. In my district, this is addressed to NIA. In my district, I have two NIS, National Irrigation System.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: And that suggests that we have thousands of irrigated farmlands.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: Producing so much number of rice.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: Kami ho ang nagsusupply ng mga, ng palay sa Gawaw, sa Cagayan de Uro, sa Marawi City.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: My only problem now is, bakit ho dalawang NIS, 5 million lang ho ang allocation?

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: Dahil sa 5 million lang ang allocation, I would, parang nakikita ko ho na ang mga repair, maintenance, as well as upkeep.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: Of the NIS is never enough.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: And therefore, it will, of course, reduce the production of rice per hectare.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: Kung hindi natin masusupplyan ng sufficient number of water, volume of water required.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: Kaya nga ho, kailangan ho sana natin madagdagan ang ating requirements.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: Siguro nakita ni Honorable Congressman ito.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: Ang proposal namin sa isa, 2 billion eh.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: Talagang 2 billion pa ang proposal namin.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: Ang pet project po namin doon na isa is yung Tago Riz.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: Nag-propose po kami doon nga ng, at saka yung repair ng Santa Filomena CIS, 250 million.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: Pero tama po kayo, dalawang 5 million lang ang lumabas, sir.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: In fact, isa ito sa pinakamalaking hingin nga natin ang punto.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: Kung meron po tayong additional, sir, babalikan po namin ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: Mr. Administrator, I have been here in Congress and I've been a vice chairman of the Committee on Appropriation for 8 years now.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: And never in any instance I heard an agency na sobrang kanilang allocation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: Ang question ko lang ho, how do you allocate that meager budget you have?

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: Kasi po, kailangan equitable ang distribution.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: Mindanao po is i-breadbasket natin, di ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: Dapat ho, may problema si Ropos, kulang.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: Si Amatod, Congressman Amatong, kulang din.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: Lahat-lahat kami yata, kulang buong Mindanao po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: Ang irony is, we are the ones supplying ng pagkain dito sa Metro Manila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: And why not put some bigger share even in the allocation of budget for irrigation?

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: Again, ulitin ko po, Mr. Chair, ang na-priority po talaga na bigyan namin ng pondo are the ongoing projects.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: But kung mapapansin, bibigyan po ko po kaya ng listahan, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: Kapag kami mga savings po ang NIA, lagi namin nilalagay po lahat sa Mindanao.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: I will give you po a list, yung modification po namin this year, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: Makikita nyo po na pupunta halos lahat sa Mindanao yung aming budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: Lastly, sinabi ni Presidente nung panahon,

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: sa Suna, na ang tataposin nila, in fact, that is also the directive to the Department of Public Works and Highways,

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: tataposin nila yung mga ongoing projects.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: In my district po, 60 milyon na lang ang kulang ng Santa Pilumina Dam.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: Sana po ang lagyan natin yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: Kasi that's the priority of the President.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: Yung tapusin yung mga proyekto ng nabimbin po.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen

segments.text: And the rest of the administration.

segments.speaker: Rep. Reynolds Michael T. Tan
segments.text: Anyway, Mr. Secretary, Mr. Chair, I have some few questions lang.

segments.speaker: Rep. Reynolds Michael T. Tan
segments.text: Pertaining to the FMR of the 2025, which we considered as FLR,

segments.speaker: Rep. Reynolds Michael T. Tan
segments.text: what is the current status of the farm-to-market roads of the 2025 budget?

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Yung sa 2025, Mr. Chair, yung sa 2025 na farm-to-market na 23 billion,

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: From what I understand, yung 5.7, i-re-release soon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Reynolds Michael T. Tan
segments.text: So, what is the reason na i-re-release yung 5 billion plus at saka yung the address na ay hindi ma-re-release?

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: I think it's more of the budget yan.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: We always request, the DA always requests, Mr. Chair, na i-release lahat yan.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: it depends sa cash flow, I guess.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: mas buwang in-advise lang kami ng DBM na i-re-release nila for now.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
Rep. Reynolds Michael T. Tan
segments.text: And in connection with the farm-to-market,

segments.speaker: Rep. Reynolds Michael T. Tan
segments.text: mabuti din na andito din si Yusek Arig.

segments.speaker: Rep. Reynolds Michael T. Tan
segments.text: He was in Saumar, I think last month.

segments.speaker: Rep. Reynolds Michael T. Tan
segments.text: So, at least nakita talaga yung situation namin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Reynolds Michael T. Tan
segments.text: So, Mr. Chair, I just wanted to raise that

segments.speaker: Rep. Reynolds Michael T. Tan
segments.text: yung detalye po nung farm-to-market is, I think, 5 meters yung width at saka 2.2 mm or meters yung thickness.

segments.speaker: Rep. Reynolds Michael T. Tan
segments.text: But, however, kasi yung situation namin sa Saumar, Secretary,

segments.speaker: Rep. Reynolds Michael T. Tan
segments.text: medyo wala pa kaming masyadong road

segments.speaker: Rep. Reynolds Michael T. Tan
segments.text: papunta mismo pa lang sa barangay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Reynolds Michael T. Tan
segments.text: Like, yung na-observe ko in some other provinces,

segments.speaker: Rep. Reynolds Michael T. Tan
segments.text: na talaga may road na sila access going to the barangay

segments.speaker: Rep. Reynolds Michael T. Tan
segments.text: and papunta na talaga sila sa farm.

segments.speaker: Rep. Reynolds Michael T. Tan
segments.text: So, sa amin, because alam mo naman yung sitwasyon natin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Reynolds Michael T. Tan
segments.text: So, medyo may mga more or less pang 10% pa kami ng mga barangays na walang road.

segments.speaker: Rep. Reynolds Michael T. Tan
segments.text: Utilize the farm-to-market leading to the barangay pa lang.

segments.speaker: Rep. Reynolds Michael T. Tan
segments.text: So, however, nagkakaroon dyan ang mga overlapping.

segments.speaker: Rep. Reynolds Michael T. Tan
segments.text: Pero, with the guidelines ngayon na 5 meters yung width at saka 200 mm.

segments.speaker: Rep. Reynolds Michael T. Tan
segments.text: So, parang it does not align with the DP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Reynolds Michael T. Tan
segments.text: Kasi sa DP is 6 meters yung width at saka mas thicker yung...

segments.speaker: Rep. Reynolds Michael T. Tan
segments.text: So, is it possible ba na pwede ba natin ma-adjust yan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Reynolds Michael T. Tan
segments.text: At least the same na lang yung sa DP at saka sa FMR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Reynolds Michael T. Tan
segments.text: Kasi parang medyo masagwa din tingnan na 6 tapos magpa-5.

segments.speaker: Rep. Reynolds Michael T. Tan
segments.text: Then, sa unahan na naman magsi-6 kung DP naman yung mag-continue.

segments.speaker: Rep. Reynolds Michael T. Tan
segments.text: So, magkakaroon kami ng konting problema.

segments.speaker: Rep. Reynolds Michael T. Tan
segments.text: So, sa physical na hitsura nung road.

segments.speaker: Rep. Reynolds Michael T. Tan
segments.text: And at the same time, pag na-open na yung road natin, medyo marami na rin yung mga vehicle na pumapasok.

segments.speaker: Rep. Reynolds Michael T. Tan
segments.text: So, chances is, the more thick yung road natin, the better yung maglalast din siya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Reynolds Michael T. Tan
segments.text: And lastly, yun sa 20% na elevation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Reynolds Michael T. Tan
segments.text: Medyo hilly kasi yung probinsya natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Reynolds Michael T. Tan
segments.text: There are a lot of winds hilly.

segments.speaker: Rep. Reynolds Michael T. Tan
segments.text: Kanal, kailangan natin ng slow protection, and so on and so forth.

segments.speaker: Rep. Reynolds Michael T. Tan
segments.text: So, I don't think na kakayanin yung 20%.

segments.speaker: Rep. Reynolds Michael T. Tan
segments.text: Baka lumagpas kami ng konti, Secretary.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Well, binabago na nga namin yung classification instead of concreting.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Ginagawa namin construction para mas may flexibility, lalo na doon sa mga terrain na medyo difficult or needs slow protection.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Sinasabi natin na mga bagong road opening at baka kulang nga yung thickness doon sa mga bagong kali dahil dating hindi pa dinadaanan.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Meron tayong option na using the same budget but using soil stabilizers muna for the first few years para nga makompact muna siya.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: But then, that's cheaper per kilometer.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: So, yun ang isang option na depende na sa inyo kung gusto nyong gamitin.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Lastly, yung whether 6 meters or 5 meters.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Well, I agree with you na mas magandang pareho na lang kami ng DP, no?

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: I guess we'll just have to talk to DP and agree.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: But of course, if we do the 60 meters by 230 meter thick, it means din, mas maikli din yung magagawa namin per year.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: So, it depends siguro kung ano yung magandang direction talaga.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
Rep. Reynolds Michael T. Tan
segments.text: And, Secretary, maybe we can consider also yung issues namin dito sa summer.

segments.text: But, of course, we will always comply with the guidance of the Department of Agriculture.
