segments.text: Yung pork cuts, yun yung kasim tsaka pigi.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: 2025 was the highest in recent history, no?

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: noong 2025, 9,000 tons a month ang importasyon.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Pero for 2026, bumaba siya to 8,000 tons a month lang.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Pero 2026, as of August 24, 25,000 tons lang.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: So bumaba actually ang importasyon for this year

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: So it means healthy yung ating industry.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Problema lang talaga, nagpa-fast break ang industriya

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: Sa Farmgate, pero ang presyo ng karne,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: Ano po ba yung intervention na ginagawa po ng DA?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: Tama po, okay lang po yan, may importation tayo. Pero short term, short term yung goal lang po ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: Ano po yung pang long term natin para po tayo makatulong sa ating mga farmers, sa ating hog raisers?

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Chair, I would just like to clarify na hindi, ang DA is not in favor of continuous importation.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Ang position namin, kung pwedeng i-restrict yan, but unfortunately, meron tayong tinusunod na WTO rules.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: At pwede lang natin i-increase ay taripa.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Nag-request na ho ang DA sa ating economic managers na kung pwedeng itaas ang taripa ng baboy at ibalik sa dating taripa.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: At ngayon, meron din tayong move na, and we are working with the tariff commission na yung jowls na tinatawag,

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: o kaya yung pangaba yun, ay i-classify.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: I-classify na hindi na siya o-false, i-classify na siya at passport cut para itaas yung taripa.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Yun ho, yun lang ang madalis at pinakamabilis na supportang pwedeng ibigay natin sa ating mga hog raisers, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: Mr. Chair, I appreciate the explanation of Secretary Laurel.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: Siyempre po, ito po naman na inquiry lamang, pero siyempre po, at the end of the day,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: this representation fully supports the approval of your budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: Sa bagong budget ng DA po at saka ng NIA, sana po huwag po natin kalimutan ang ating mga maliliit na backyard hog raisers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: Yun lamang po, and thank you po, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Yes, definitely the DA would like to help the livestock sector, lalo na yung mga nagbababoy at nagmamanok.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: At sa bagong budget na makukuha namin for the livestock, talagang repopulation and increase in population,

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: langan para mabawasan ang importasyon at makalaban tayo, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Secretary. Thank you, Congresswoman Christina. The next

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Sa isa, from the minority, Representative Ma'am Zubiri.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Mr. Chair. At magandang hapon po sa ating mga bisita galing sa Department of Agriculture,

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: lalong-lalo na sa ating butihing Secretary, Secretary Francisco Chula.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: Bago po ako mag-umpisa, sana payagan niyo po ako na magbida ng konti tungkol sa Bukidnon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: Because this year po, naglabasan ng report for 2025 na Bukidnon is the top province in value of production in agriculture and fisheries and crop production

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: out of the 2.42 trillion pesos output of the Philippines.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: And so out of that 2.42, ang Bukidnon po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: Sa agriculture and fisheries, 162.3 billion pesos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: Habang ang sumusunod po ay nasa 94.2 billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: Ang crop production po ng Bukidnon ay nasa 105.58 billion pesos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: Habang ang sumusunod ay nasa 50.18 billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: Habang ang livestock po, out of the 420 billion ng country,

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: ang output coming from Bukidnon is 36.09 billion pesos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: And syempre, gusto ko po magpasalamat sa ating mga kaibigan sa DA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: Dahil syempre, alam ko naman po na hindi natin ma-achieve ang mga numbers na ito kung wala ang full support ng Department of Agriculture

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: sa aming farms, sa aming mga farmers, and sa local government unit and provincial government unit ng Bukidnon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: So thank you very much, Secretary, sa inyong full support.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: And we hope na ngayong 2026, kami pa rin ang top performer.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: I would like to inquire, kasi given nga our numbers, may nabasa lang ako dito sa ating reports na medyo nalito lang ako ng konti.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: So I would like to ask for clarification from our friends sa NIA tungkol sa ating Bukidnon 3rd District budget from the NIA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: Kasi ang nakalagay po dito was yung RDC endorsed noong 2025, nasa 772 million.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: Noong 2010, habang sa 2027, ang RDC endorsed is 273 million.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: And may I clarify lang, kasi dito sa ating form dito, ang nakalagay sa NEP for Bukidnon 3rd District ay zero.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: But I would like to clarify this, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: So we can discuss this further kung ano ba talaga ang tamang amount para sa Bukidnon with our friends from the NIA.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: Please just give me a time.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: Kasi siguro, gaya nga nang sabi ko, napakaganda ng mga output natin sa Bukidnon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: So I would like to clarify this.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: Hindi naman siguro, kaya maganda mag-clarify muna.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Pinakamagandang record ang Bukidnon, tapos according to Congresswoman, is zero.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: Kaya ako nagulat din dahil na...

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: Alam ko naman, ang Bukidnon talaga isa sa pinapangandang probinsya pagdating sa agrikultura.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: And you know, pupunta kami sa opisina niyo, makikipag-tulungan po kami.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: So itong ating current figure dito, hindi pa naman final?

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: Hindi lang nila na-update, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: I'm sorry, could you repeat that please?

segments.speaker: NIA Administrator Eduardo Eddie G. Guillen
segments.text: Yes, bukang hindi po nila, hindi po updated yung...

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: Bukang, baka nahulog yung isang one.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: Sige, okay. I'm glad to hear that.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: Kasi syempre, you know, ayoko naman na hindi natin ma-keep up yung ating reputation as Bukidnon being the top producer.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: E pag nawalan kami ng support from the NIA, may hirapan kami to produce all this agriculture,

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: which I think is very badly needed by our country.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: And I would like to think that Department of Agriculture, especially NIA, will continue to support Bukidnon

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: para we can continue to support the country's agricultural needs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: Okay, thank you very much to our director.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: Our second doc, my second question, of course, goes to our friends from the SRA.

segments.speaker: SRA Administrator Pablo Luis S. Azcona
segments.text: Good afternoon po, Mr. Chair. Good afternoon, ma'am.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: So, last year, I remember we worked quite closely.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: And trying to increase the budget, or actually trying to increase the budget of the SRA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: Because, syempre, as a sugar-producing province, talagang nakikita namin ang impact at ang napakalaking effect at tulong ng SRA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: And we wanted to increase your budget from 2 billion to maybe 3 or 4, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: Kaya lang, I was very disappointed to find out that, number one, hindi natin na-increase ang inyong budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: And even more so, more disappointed to discover na yung 2 billion na dapat naka-alot sa inyo,

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: So, 1 billion pa rin lang ang naibigay sa inyo sa ating last budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: Do you mind updating me on why, what was the final explanation? Bakit 1 billion lang napunta sa inyo?

segments.speaker: SRA Administrator Pablo Luis S. Azcona
segments.text: Yeah, Mr. Chair, we were informed of, once again, utilization problems.

segments.speaker: SRA Administrator Pablo Luis S. Azcona
segments.text: So, there has been new guidelines on procurement, which actually delayed a lot of our utilization.

segments.speaker: SRA Administrator Pablo Luis S. Azcona
segments.text: So, we're still hoping to make it up in the last 3 years.

segments.speaker: SRA Administrator Pablo Luis S. Azcona
segments.text: We're also planning po, ma'am, to reallocate some of the budget into our quick response fund for the RSSI infection,

segments.speaker: SRA Administrator Pablo Luis S. Azcona
segments.text: as well as the mitigation on El Niño.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: What programs or mandates of the SRA are currently affected by this lack of budget?

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: Would you be able to tell me?

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: Or because of the insufficient appropriations?

segments.speaker: SRA Administrator Pablo Luis S. Azcona
SRA Administrator Pablo Luis S. Azcona
segments.text: since the SIDA program po is pre-allocated by the law,

segments.speaker: SRA Administrator Pablo Luis S. Azcona
segments.text: so, from 2 billion to 1 billion po, it cuts everything by 50%.

segments.speaker: SRA Administrator Pablo Luis S. Azcona
segments.text: So, malaki po yung effect sa amin po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: So, parang across the board, talagang naka-annuation proportion din siya?

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: So, lahat yan, kasama yung ating mga infrastructure, yung ating mga block farm programs, ating mga scholarships, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: Lahat yan matatamaan, especially, and I think this is not the time for that to happen,

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: Okay, ng threat ng El Niño na hinaharap natin, and syempre yung ating RSSI.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: And with regard to RSSI, I'm very happy because the last time nag-usap tayo,

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: alam ko na nga ako ang SRA na maghahatid kayo ng Presidential Assistance for Farmers program sa Bukidnon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: May I ask on the status of that current program?

segments.speaker: SRA Administrator Pablo Luis S. Azcona
segments.text: Yeah, we're still ongoing po, ma'am, on the releases.

segments.speaker: SRA Administrator Pablo Luis S. Azcona
segments.text: Yung total po na ayuda for the whole industry, umabot na ng 420-something.

segments.speaker: SRA Administrator Pablo Luis S. Azcona
SRA Administrator Pablo Luis S. Azcona
segments.text: So, we have, this is, most of it is coming from the SWD, and as of my last knowledge,

segments.speaker: SRA Administrator Pablo Luis S. Azcona
segments.text: we released, I think, almost 100 million already.

segments.speaker: SRA Administrator Pablo Luis S. Azcona
segments.text: So, this is farmers and workers na po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: Out of that 100 billion, how much was allocated for Bukidnon?

segments.speaker: SRA Administrator Pablo Luis S. Azcona
segments.text: I am not currently aware of the percentage, ma'am.

segments.speaker: SRA Administrator Pablo Luis S. Azcona
segments.text: I'll provide you with the information.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: Okay, I will look forward to that information.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: Sana, since given that Bukidnon is one of the...

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: one of the biggest sugar-producing portions of our country,

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: and currently, actually, nag-umpisa tayo at only about 30 hectares.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: Pero sa ngayon, ang aking latest calculation na natanggap ay nasa 576 hectares na in just a span of 3 months.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: So, I'm deeply concerned as to how much more we're going to be looking at.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: And my last question is, of course, for our friends from the DA and Region 10,

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: ang understanding ko is, meron kayong request, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: For expanding our laboratory budget, for our laboratory budget from our DA in Region 10.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: Currently, magkano ba ang budget na nakatanggap ng ating regional office

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: para sa mga biological control and other issues such as that?

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
segments.text: Yung, in terms of capacity to respond to RISIS-I,

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
segments.text: Now, when the RISIS-I reaches up to 1.1% infection rate,

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
segments.text: we raise our capacity to 20 hectares.

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
segments.text: Three weeks ago, we have a discussion with the SRA in Bukidnon.

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
segments.text: We raise it to 30 hectares, which means every day,

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
segments.text: we can supply biological control up to 30 hectares per day,

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
segments.text: totaling to, in a week, we can actually supply up to 3, 6, 9, 12, 15,

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
segments.text: We computed it in terms of the infection rate.

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
segments.text: I don't have the specific budget,

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
segments.text: but I want to respond on our capacity to deliver response to RISIS-I.

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
segments.text: Before the end of this year,

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
segments.text: our estimate is that we can respond up to 100 hectares per day,

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
segments.text: which is more than enough with the infection rate of around 0.7% per month since January.

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
segments.text: So, we have also a plan to increase first quarter of next year.

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
segments.text: So, that we can apply every day 100 hectares,

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
segments.text: so that it is more than enough with the existing 2.2% infected sugarcane out of 45,000 hectares.

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
segments.text: So, yung estimate namin, if we work together with SRA in responding farmers who want biological control,

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
segments.text: Ang tinitinan lang namin, yung early infestation at saka yung nasa low pa,

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
segments.text: Ngayon, we have mapped out yung direction.

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
segments.text: From east to west, from west to ano.

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
segments.text: So that, more or less, we can preposition our inputs.

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
segments.text: more or less, 150 million that we propose as a quick response fund

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
segments.text: so that we will not reach up to 5% infection rate.

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
segments.text: Right now, the DE has identified three levels of infection.

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
segments.text: The below, low, moderate, at saka severe.

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
segments.text: we can exactly respond to the situation

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
segments.text: knowing that before the end of this year,

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
segments.text: we can increase our capacity po.

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: So, I'm glad to hear na meron tayong mga plano.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: Pero ang tanong ko is, kahit ma-increase natin yung capacity natin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: eventually before the end of the year,

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: as you said, to how many hectares per day,

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: mahahabol ba natin yung ating infection rate?

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: Kasi right now, nakita natin from 30 hectares,

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: nasa 576 na tayo in just three months.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: So, in another one to two months,

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: baka yung 576 nasa 1,000 plus hectares na or even 2,000.

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
segments.text: Kasi kasama nung ginawa yung Crystal Milling Corporation,

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
segments.text: we helped them start their own laboratory.

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
segments.text: In fact, our meeting last time with Mr. Lorenzo,

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
segments.text: who heads the farmers group for sugarcane,

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
segments.text: he only needs 20 hectares per day.

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
segments.text: But we were able to increase it up to 30.

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
segments.text: So, with the participation of private sector who owns laboratory,

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
segments.text: we can actually maintain it, ma'am,

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
segments.text: Right now, with the increasing participation of owners of...

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
segments.text: milling company na dalawa sa bukid nun. Sa tingin ko before the end of this year, kaya namin nating hindi lalag pa sa 5% po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: That's good to hear. That's good news. Thank you very much, Director Pacamalan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: And so as a final question, magkano kaya ang kailangan na budget ng DA Region 10 in order to reach that capacity,

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: to increase para maabot niyo yung capacity na yan?

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
segments.text: Yung disubmit namin as part ng Quick Response Fund is nasa P150 million po.

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: P150 million, yes. And sa tingin natin itong magkano ang mawawala sa atin kung ang bukid nun,

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: hindi natin makontrol ang RSSI at grumabit talaga ito, mawalan talaga ng kontrol, magkano mawawala sa atin?

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
segments.text: Malaki po kasi bukid nun has 45,000 hectares of sugarcane and I think that's more than a billion.

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
segments.text: And the reason why we automatically increase our capacity is we are very conscious about not going beyond 5%.

segments.speaker: DA Region X Regional Executive Director Jose Apollo Y. Pacamalan
segments.text: It's very important commodity in bukid nun talaga.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: So parang bali yung ating increase is not even 10% of how much value we are getting from bukid nun, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: And given the fact na bukid nun is producing not just sugar but also corn and palay, which can also be affected by RSSI,

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: I think this is a very small investment with very large returns for the DA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: We can get that funded po, Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: And of course, Mr. Secretary, I would also like to add na yun nga yung ating sa SRA,

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: given that SRA is also helping out by using the money for quick response,

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: sana ma-continue natin yung ating goal of not just giving SRA the right budget but really increasing the SRA budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: What are these problems with acquisition?

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: I'm sorry, you were saying earlier, I'd like to go back to that.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: Nagiging bottleneck natin sa acquisition ba, you said, sa procedure?

segments.speaker: SRA Administrator Pablo Luis S. Azcona
SRA Administrator Pablo Luis S. Azcona
segments.text: There were new rules, I think, MARB and stuff like that, which delayed our procurement.

segments.speaker: SRA Administrator Pablo Luis S. Azcona
segments.text: But we're making it up, no, actually, for the last quarter of the year.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: Thank you to our Administrator Ascona, to Director.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: Mr. Pamalacan, and of course, to Secretary Chula Aurel.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: Rest assured, this representation is more than happy not just to support but to add.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: I really wish we can add more to our DA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: So let's work on that together para Bukidnon can continue to also add to the production value of the country.

segments.speaker: Rep. Audrey Kay T. Zubiri
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: The next is from the majority, Representative Nicanor Briones.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: And our President of the Partylist Coalition, President Pina Cacigang, and also good afternoon to Secretary Chula Aurel and the family,

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: also to Administrator Guillen and NIA family.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: First, I would like to thank our hardworking and good secretary of the Department of Agriculture and Culture

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: for the request that she mentioned earlier, the use of the ASF vaccine for commercial use.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: First, what we are looking for is a special import permit for quick implementation and import.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: Ang ibibigay niya ay ang approval ng commercial use.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: ng commercial use ibig sabihin yan yung ating 16 million piglets to partner for one year

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: ay magkakaroon na ng bakuna libre na yung one month old up to six months old

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: na tamaan ng asm so thank you mr secretary kasama yung ating usek danti palabre ka

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: ating tinawagan ka o tag gulan delikado pero nagawa ng paraan thank you very much

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: so isa pang maganda yung kay usek ano na maari asisperes usek na ini-increase yung ating taripa

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: ng jowls from five percent na isinasama sa mga opals alam nyo ba yung opals yung opals yung

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: so tama lang na ating increase yan from five percent to 15 to 25 percent and eventually

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: pagka increase yung 30 to 40 na sinabi naman ang ating palihim ating usek na itataas din

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: isa pang dapat namin pagpasalamat yung pagdaalaw ng

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: presidente sa anong sekretary kiko laurel doon sa batangas egg producers cooperative

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: na itinayo natin sometime 2010 and then ngayon problema namin ang pagbibenta ng itlog

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: pagkabagsak ang presyo so ito yung ito yung remedyo na magkaroon ng

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: itlog na ika nga may innovation at modern facilities para matulungan yung ating mag-iitlog

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: which is yung batangas especially yung san Jose egg basket of the Philippines we are

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: producing 12 million eggs a day so dahil meron ng liquefied pasteurized egg na two weeks

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: na dalawang linggo hanggang dalawang buwan na tatagal ang itlog.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: Meron tayong pag nilagyan ng asin, dalawang taon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: Meron tayong powdered eggs, up to two years, pwede. Nagawa nila na magkaroon tayo ng mga equipment na ganyan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: Yung boiled eggs in brine solution, six months na pwedeng tumagal.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: Yung boiled eggs at yung frozen egg, six months.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: So napakagandang tulong nito at pag nagamit, wala nang magiging problema

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: kahit na bumagsak yung presyo ng itlog.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Secretary, and especially to President BBM, because the funds that are

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: being given to the cooperatives are huge, like BEPCO, CIDC, LIMCOMA, Vision, all of

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: them have hundreds of millions of grants.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: Now, Mr. Secretary, when it comes to our budget, we have already mentioned the IDCA,

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: Animal Industry Development Competitiveness Enhancement Fund Act, that we have an ANSEP

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: of more or less 20, it can be 30 billion a year for 10 years.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: I know that it is included in our…

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: Hopefully, we can find a way to have a budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: The ASF and AI vaccine, I think it is more or less 1 billion, Secretary, because once

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: there is an outbreak, we already have funds that we can use to stop the spread of ASF

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: or do you think, Secretary, that we will have a budget?

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Chair, thank you very much.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: And we will put that in our request for an amendment to the BBM and we can put a 1 billion

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: But the 1 billion budget for vaccines can be for AI or for ASF, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: There, Secretary, thank you, if we can do it.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: One more, Secretary, in the ANSEP, I…

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: If we can put a fund, we can put a fund on the SEPA or all examination facilities for

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: agriculture, or the first border inspection facilities, because we can avoid biosecurity

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: and not bring diseases to the imported agricultural products.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: And secondly, we can reduce smuggling.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Chair, meron na tayong pondo for 2026 for implementation na namin for three sites

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: sa Subic, sa Manila, tsaka sa Davao.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: But of course, kung kulang pa yun, magagamit din natin yung pera from IDCA para doon for

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Meron lang kaming konting issue sa maning dahil hindi kami makapag-hire ng dagdag

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: tao dahil sa ruling na linabas while may batas naman na pwede kami dapat.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: So, we're just sorting it out with DBM, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: Alam niyo, hindi po kami total sa importation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: Pero sana, doon lang sa pangangailangan na ating mamamayan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: Baka po mali yung mga reports.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: Kasi pag tinumpit po natin yung in-import this year, kung meron 851 million, yung total

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: meat imports ng pork, which is alam naman natin, yung opals, yung skin, fats, may possibility

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: na yan ay tunay na pork.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: So, ang hiling lang namin, Mr. Secretary, bawasan naman kasi lahat ng ating ginagawa,

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: kung magbebenta ang ating mga farmers ng lugi.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: So, hopefully, yung reference value, magkaroon kayo ng transaction value na maa-advise ang

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: DA at saka mga industry farmers na ito yung tamang transaction value para hindi tayo nagagawa

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: ng reference value na napakalayo sa presyo ng ini-import na karning agricultural products,

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: We will do that, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Since we have been here for a few hours now, I would like to suspend the proceeding for

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: a few minutes so we can take a health break.
